Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

  • display_name - (Optional) (Updatable) A user-friendly display name for the migration.
  • description - (Optional) (Updatable) A user-friendly description for the migration.
  • freeform_tags - (Optional) (Updatable) Free-form tags for this migration.
  • defined_tags - (Optional) (Updatable) Defined tags for this migration.
  • source_database_connection_id - (Optional) (Updatable) The source connection reference for the migration.
  • target_database_connection_id - (Optional) (Updatable) The target connection reference for the migration.
  • type - (Required) (Updatable) The migration type.
  • data_transfer_medium_details - (Optional) (Updatable) The published controller-backed Migration rollout only supports the OBJECT_STORAGE variant from the checked-in CRD surface.
  • initial_load_settings - (Optional) (Updatable) Initial-load configuration for the migration.
  • advisor_settings - (Optional) (Updatable) Advisor configuration for the migration.
  • hub_details - (Optional) (Updatable) GoldenGate hub configuration for the migration.
  • ggs_details - (Optional) (Updatable) GoldenGate deployment settings for the migration.
  • advanced_parameters - (Optional) (Updatable) Advanced Oracle-only migration parameters.
  • source_container_database_connection_id - (Optional) (Updatable) Oracle container database connection reference.
  • source_standby_database_connection_id - (Optional) (Updatable) Oracle standby database connection reference.
  • compartment_id - (Required) Updating this field after creation is not supported.
  • assessment_id - (Optional) Updating this field after creation is not supported.
  • database_combination - (Required) Updating this field after creation is not supported.
  • include_objects - (Optional) The published controller-backed Migration rollout does not support the object-helper families behind this field.
  • exclude_objects - (Optional) The published controller-backed Migration rollout does not support the object-helper families behind this field.
  • bulk_include_exclude_data - (Optional) The published controller-backed Migration rollout does not support the object-helper families behind this field.
